environment: $defaults
### Org-wide (shared base for Andrew's machines)
**Organization**: Andrew Rich, solo developer. Primary use: software development and personal dev-infrastructure automation (git hooks, Claude Code config, CI workflows)

**GitHub owners**: `smartwatermelon` (org; public OSS by default), `twistedmelonman` (user account; public by default), `nightowlstudiollc` (org; commercial, private by default except website/client work)

**Source control / trusted repos**: any local git repo whose `origin` is on github.com under `smartwatermelon`, `twistedmelonman`, or `nightowlstudiollc`, plus that remote. These are trusted push and PR destinations. The set of repos varies by machine and over time, so trust follows the remote's owner, not a list. Repos and remotes under any other owner are outside this trust boundary

**Repository visibility**: varies per repo and changes over time; check the current repo with `gh repo view --json visibility` rather than assuming. If it cannot be checked, use the owner's default above, and treat a `nightowlstudiollc` repo as PRIVATE. A PUBLIC repo means only that repo's own work may be published there; confidential or secret material is never cleared by visibility
**Trusted internal domains**: the LAN hosts asiago.local, tilsit.local, mimolette.local, parmesan.local (Andrew's personal Macs). arich-mac.local is a COMPANY machine: read-only access only

**Secrets management**: 1Password CLI (`op read`, service account scoped to the `Automation` vault) and the macOS Keychain (`security find-generic-password`) hold API tokens. Reading a token to pass it directly to its own service (GitHub, Anthropic, ntfy.sh) is normal; writing or deleting entries is not routine. claude-wrapper loads `GH_TOKEN` and per-owner `GH_TOKEN_SWM` / `GH_TOKEN_NOS` / `GH_TOKEN_TWM` at launch. CI secrets are referenced by name only. Never print a token value

**Merge policy**: every `gh pr merge` goes through a gh wrapper that runs pre-merge-review.sh and requires CI green plus, on repos that keep it, a human-created merge-lock (`merge-lock authorize`, human-only, 30-minute TTL, blocked for agents by a PreToolUse hook). `main` is the default branch and is protected, but branch protection is NOT the review gate on these repos; the wrapper and merge-lock are
**Key internal services**: GitHub Actions (CI), Netlify (production sites), ntfy.sh (alerts)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Network posture**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any `.env*`, `credentials.json`, `.claude/secrets.op`, `.secrets.baseline`, `*.p8`/`*.p12`/`*.pem`, and 1Password item contents, in any repo; share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
### Per-repo specifics (apply only when working in that repo)

**dev-env** (smartwatermelon, PUBLIC): infrastructure docs, design plans and hook extensions for Andrew's Claude Code setup; not an application. Routine: shellcheck and the test suites under `scripts/org-migration/`, `scripts/dependabot-digest/`, `scripts/site-monitor/`. CI secrets by name only: DIGEST_APP_CLIENT_ID, DIGEST_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, NTFY_TOPIC

**kebab-tax** (nightowlstudiollc, PRIVATE): React Native/Expo mobile app plus Cloudflare Workers backend; confidential material is fine here. Deploy targets: GitHub Actions, EAS builds for iOS/Android, Cloudflare Workers `valuation-api` (production) and `valuation-api-staging`. Services: valuation-api.andrew-3c6.workers.dev (production), valuation-api-staging.andrew-3c6.workers.dev, RevenueCat, appstoreconnect.apple.com, api.cloudflare.com. Sensitive: `mobile/credentials.json`, `scripts/sync-build-host-secrets.sh`, `workers/valuation-api/tests/test-secret-validation.sh`, `docs/post-mortems/2025-12-18-missing-revenuecat-secret.md`. CI secrets by name only: CHANGELOG_PUBLISHER_PAT, CLAUDE_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Routine under `.claude/`, `mobile/`, `workers/valuation-api/`: test runs, local builds, Maestro E2E
### User-specific
**Org-specific CLIs**: `op` (1Password CLI), `merge-lock` (PR merge-lock authorize/check), `gh` and `git` (both wrapped by dotfiles functions), `claude-config-deploy`
allow: Merging with `gh pr merge <N> --squash --delete-branch` on a repo owned by smartwatermelon, nightowlstudiollc or twistedmelonman is allowed: a local wrapper refuses the merge unless CI is green and, where required, Andrew created a merge-lock for that PR. Does NOT cover --admin, --auto, or merges through gh api.

Commenting on, labeling, or closing GitHub issues and PRs in repos owned by smartwatermelon, nightowlstudiollc or twistedmelonman is allowed when it is part of the task the user gave; a PreToolUse hook gates commit, PR and issue text only for Beacon and third-party destinations, plus public-facing copy files. Text under these three owners is exempt unless the hook blocks.
soft_deny: Any write over ssh to arich-mac.local (company machine): read-only commands only.
